proposed_delta.name: MemorySalienceProjection
proposed_delta.placement: WP300-derived helper feeding WP301 AXIS_TEMPORAL and AXIS_STATE RetrievalSignal values; WP302 remains unchanged downstream
input_contract: exact MemoryLifecycleState or equivalent exact memory_id + generation + state SHA-256 fence
explicit non-negative integer anchor_tick with anchor_tick <= reference_tick
anchor_kind such as CREATION_EVIDENCE or VERIFIED_USE_EVIDENCE
non-empty anchor_evidence_refs; authenticity/admission remains upstream authority

policy_contract.superseded_behavior: no normal salience selection path; preserve existing WP301 redirect-only behavior
policy_contract.parameter_authority: UNSET_BY_TRIGGER6; Trigger4 must choose/test bounded parameters or keep them explicit caller policy inputs

output_contract: one WP301-compatible AXIS_TEMPORAL RetrievalSignal with basis-point score and evidence refs
one WP301-compatible AXIS_STATE RetrievalSignal with basis-point score and evidence refs
projection SHA-256 binding memory state identity, policy identity and all salience evidence
proposed_delta.verified_use_rule: Mere retrieval, selection, familiarity, model mention, or retrieval-count increment MUST NOT advance anchor_tick by default. A VERIFIED_USE_EVIDENCE anchor requires a separately typed downstream outcome/use evidence reference; this contract binds the reference but does not mint its authenticity.

baseline.current_wp300: explicit lifecycle state only; DEGRADED preserves payload/provenance and has no automatic rank penalty
baseline.current_wp301: deterministic caller-supplied evidence-bound multi-axis ranking including TEMPORAL and STATE axes
baseline.current_wp302: consumes/validates WP301 derived scores as familiarity input; no decay policy
baseline.e4_control_result: with neutral temporal/state scores, old DEGRADED example rank 47000 > recent ACTIVE 44000
baseline.e4_decay_strawman_result: with explicit temporal/state decay signals, recent ACTIVE 43000 > old DEGRADED 32000
baseline.e4_feedback_strawman_result: 20 naive retrieval-count boosts restore old DEGRADED rank to 47000 > recent ACTIVE 43000

measurement_plan_for_trigger4: reproduce E4 three-policy ranking ablation using the actual candidate implementation
measure deterministic equality across repeated runs
measure per-candidate projection CPU time and allocation overhead against current WP301 candidate construction
stress large integer tick delta for overflow/bounds behavior
run feedback-loop adversarial test where repeated retrieval occurs without verified-use evidence and prove salience does not increase
run positive verified-use test with independently typed evidence input and prove only the explicit evidence anchor changes the temporal score
counterhypotheses: Caller-defined TEMPORAL/STATE scores are sufficient and a shared projection adds unnecessary policy surface.
Lifecycle DEGRADED should remain purely descriptive and never influence retrieval automatically.
Retrieval frequency is a useful implicit reinforcement signal and strict verified-use evidence will make adaptive recall too conservative.
falsifiers: If a thin projection cannot improve stale-vs-recent prioritization without materially increasing complexity or coupling, reject it.
If degraded status proves intentionally orthogonal to retrieval under current owner/architecture authority, do not wire a default state penalty; retain only explicit temporal evidence support.
If verified-use evidence cannot be distinguished at an upstream typed boundary, do not implement automatic anchor refresh.

expected_effects.quality: bounded non-destructive forgetting semantics using already-supported WP301 axes
expected_effects.storage: no canonical payload deletion; projection may remain ephemeral/rebuildable
expected_effects.latency: integer arithmetic plus hashing per projection; measure in Trigger4
